name: Ma'akah (Son of Nahor and his concubine Reumah)
title: Son of Nahor through the concubine Reumah
summary: Ma'akah was one of the sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, born to his concubine Reumah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 22 as part of Nahor's descendants. Ma'akah is considered the ancestor of the Aramean people known as the Ma'akatites, who later settled in the area east of the Jordan River.

keyEvents.title: Nahor's descendants through Reumah
keyEvents.description: After listing the sons of Nahor with his wife Milcah, the text also mentions the children he had with his concubine Reumah, including Ma'akah.

keyEvents.title: The Context of Maacah's Birth
keyEvents.description: Maacah's birth is mentioned in connection with the news Abraham received about Nahor's family, after Abraham had passed the test of faith with Isaac on Mount Moriah.

keyEvents.title: The Maacathites as a People
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Maacah developed into the people known as the Maacathites, who are mentioned in connection with the division of the land and Israel's wars in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The Kingdom of Maacah in Connection with Geshur
keyEvents.description: The kingdom of Maacah is mentioned as a small Aramean kingdom east of the Jordan River, at the foot of Mount Hermon, and was among the peoples the Israelites did not drive out.

keyEvents.title: The Maacathites at War Against Israel
keyEvents.description: The people of Maacah are mentioned among those hired by the Ammonites to fight against King David and Israel.
